$comment: Computed-style fingerprint of the rendered homepage, captured from a real browser against the UK store. This is the tripwire for typography work: tokenising must not move any of it. If `hash` changes, something in the cascade moved and must be explained before the change is accepted. Recapture with the snippet in scripts/README-style-check.md.
notes: Assistant is Shopify's font_picker output and dominates the page (199 of 430 signatures). It is NOT one of the brand PP fonts.
Arial renders on 25 signatures and must stay Arial.
Libre Baskerville and Times New Roman appear unintentionally but are live behaviour — they are recorded, not corrected.
The theme declares 32 distinct font stacks (see: npm run fonts:report) but only 18 actually compute, because several stacks name the same family with different fallbacks.
